items.evidence: README play command (examen leverage play work --ticks 0 --settings S) printed one JSON object, screen title, with all keys the brief names (tick..records) and the no-season defaults.
play ... --frame X.png --size 800x480 wrote PNGs; `file` reports 800 x 480 RGBA for title, stall, day, morning, upgrades, paused, evening, slots, settings, season over.

Fresh place: texts [Day Market, New season, Records, Stamps, Settings, Quit], menu_index 0; Down x7 stops at 4, Up x6 stops at 0, Left changes nothing; down x4 + enter on Quit ended a 50-tick run at tick 5 with the state printed.

Settings opened with Language: English / Difficulty: Normal / Season: 7 days; Left/Right stepped en<->es, easy/normal/hard, 7<->3 days and stopped at both ends; Escape and Enter on Back returned to the title.

Run 1 set es/hard/3 days; run 2 on the same --settings folder showed es, hard, 3 and Spanish title texts (from tick 1); fresh folder gave en/normal/7, slots [null,null,null], stamps [], records []. (A 0-tick run prints the defaults: see defects.)

One Spanish run through title, settings, slots, morning, stall, day, paused, evening, upgrades (incl. Monedas insuficientes), season over, records, stamps: every text Spanish except 'Day Market'; settings texts switched to Ajustes/Idioma: Espanol on the same tick as Right.
modules/work/data/strings/en.json and es.json hold the strings; README 'Add a language' section says to copy en.json, translate, add lang.xx and one LANGS line.
Fresh place, Enter on New season: texts [New season, Slot 1: Empty, Slot 2: Empty, Slot 3: Empty]; Escape went to title.

Enter on slot 1: screen morning, day 1, slot 1, coins 50, reputation 50, all stock [], prices apples 4 bread 6 cheese 11 fish 14 flowers 7 honey 9, upgrades [], crate_limit 8, order null, texts Morning / Day 1 of 7 / Coins: 50.
Easy season coins 60; Hard+3 days coins 40, 'Day 1 of 3', forecast of 3; Normal/7 season saved, settings changed to hard/3, Continue gave season_difficulty normal, season_length 7, 'Day 1 of 7'.
Seeds 1-12: forecast 7 entries of sun/cloud/rain/heat, weather = forecast[day-1] and 'Weather: X' matches (Cloud, Heat, Rain seen); same seed repeated the same forecast.
Wholesale over 12 seeds stayed in apples 1-4, bread 2-5, cheese 5-8, fish 6-9, flowers 2-5, honey 4-7; rows read 'Apples: 4 a unit, stock 0' etc. matching wholesale and stock.
Enter on Apples at 4: coins 50->26, apples [{units 6, days_left 5}]; again: coins 2, one batch of 12, row 'stock 12'. Honey lot gave days_left null.
Coins 2, Enter on Apples: coins/stock unchanged, 'Not enough coins' added, gone after the next word (down). Bread at 96 units with 203 coins: 17th lot changed nothing (stock stays 96).
Day 1 order null; day 2 order {honey, 4, pay 54 = 4*9*3/2}, text 'Order: 4 Honey for 54'; accept -> taken true, 'Order taken: 4 Honey for 54'; second accept no change.
Later run on same place: title [.., New season, Continue, Records, ..]; Continue slots row 'Slot 1: Day 1 of 7, 50 coins'.

Day-3 Morning saved in run 1 (seed 1); run 2 with --seed 5, Continue > slot 1: full state (coins, stock incl. honey batch, stall, prices, forecast, wholesale, order, upgrades) identical to the unbroken run's Morning; Enter on empty slots 2/3 changed nothing.

Escape on Morning/Stall/Day -> paused [Paused, Resume, Title]; clock stayed 1 for 15 ticks while paused, Escape/Resume returned to same screen and state; Title after buying apples left slot at 50 coins and Continue reopened the Morning with 50 coins, no stock.
Stall opened with cursor (0,0), selected apples, texts Stall, Good: Apples, Price: 4, Stock: 6 (6 apples held), Crates: 0 of 8.
Up (0,0)->(0,1), Up again stays; Down to (0,0), Down stays; Left stays at x 0; Right x6 stops at x 5.
next_good x6: bread, cheese, fish, flowers, honey, apples; prev_good from apples -> honey; Good/Price/Stock texts followed each step.
put added {x,y,good} and Crates N of 8 rose; put on occupied cell and 9th put changed nothing; take removed the crate (Crates 1->0), take on empty cell changed nothing.
Bread price_up x14 stopped at 18 (3x6); apples price_down x5 stopped at 1; 'Price:' text followed.
Day-2 Stall showed day-1 crates and prices; after save and Continue in a later run (other seed) stall and prices were identical.
Enter on Stall: screen day, clock 0, speed slow, texts '08:00' and 'Speed: Slow', taken/served/walked_out/passed 0, visitors list of 71.
Script over the list: ids 1..n, minutes strictly increasing within 0-479, types valid, distinct wants 2/1/2/3 by type; same seed in two fresh places identical; seed 2 gave another list.

--at per tick: slow 20 ticks/minute, fast 5, rush 1, hold froze clock (02 for 20 ticks) while tick advanced on screen day; slow->fast after 10 ticks reached 08:01 after 3 fast ticks (progress kept); time/Speed texts followed.
finish at tick 22 -> evening at the next printed tick, clock 480; final state identical (byte-equal output) to the same day run at rush.
Same day at slow (9640 ticks), fast, rush, and fast/hold/rush/slow/rush mix: identical evening outputs (same md5) for coins, taken, served, walked_out, passed, sales, stock.
Per-minute states of 4 full days (seeds 1 and 3) checked by script: every visitor on aisle exactly for clocks m..m+5 with x = clock - m, off from m+6; 0 violations.

Script over 4 days without Sign: first good taken by an empty basket always from the front crate of its column, later goods from front/back of its column only, all on wants and not already held; 0 violations.
Cook 11 (minute 93) at column 0, apples 4: basket 2 apples at 4 at clock 93, budget_left 32. Apples at 5: only tourists bought; at 6 tourists 19,30,31,57,70 bought 1 each; at 7 no sales.
Script: no take with units*price above budget_left (budget_left + spent = budget always), held units of each good in aisle/queue/tills never above its stock; 0 violations.
Script: empty-basket visitors gone at m+6 with passed +1 each; visitors with goods in queue with joined m+6 or straight at a free till; 0 violations.

Script: till ends = start + 2 + goods in basket; coins and taken rose by paid; bargain paid total - total/10; served/reputation +1; sale entry at end minute. Two apple batches (days 4 and 5): sales drew from the days-4 batch first.
Script: never a free till with a non-empty queue after a minute; e.g. till ending at 147 took the visitor leaving the aisle at 147; single-good buyers paid at exit+3 (at till from exit minute).

Over 8 played days (busy stalls, rep up to 100) the queue never exceeded 1 and no visitor walked out, so no queued wait reached patience and the walk-out effects (goods back, reputation -2, walked_out +1) could not be seen. Code at lib.rs:824 looks right but the item needs observed behaviour.
At clock 479 visitors still on aisle; at evening clock 480, aisle/queue/tills empty, passed/walked_out/served unchanged from minute 479 (3 days checked).
With Second till: tills had 2 entries, both serving at once (e.g. clock 43: visitors 6 and 7); when both were free the arriving visitor went to till 1 in 48/48 cases.
With Sign, honey only at back cell (5,1) behind a bread crate: 6 visitors bought honey alone (baskets empty when they looked).
Taken honey order with 6 honey: 'Order delivered: 54', coins +54, honey 6->2. Taken without stock: 'Order failed', reputation 61->56. Not taken: no line, reputation 61.

Bread bought day 3 (unsold) 'spoiled 6' that evening; fish bought day 2 had days_left 1 after day 2 and 'Fish: ... spoiled 6' on day 3; honey kept days_left null over several days; spoiled 12 in state.
Seed 3 heat day 2: apples bought at 5 days were 3 after the evening without Cool box, 4 with Cool box.
Rent: 30 at Normal with 5 crates, 25 at Easy with 5 crates, 32 at Hard with 1 crate, 36 at Normal with 8 crates; coins reduced by it.

Evening texts Evening, Day 1 of 7, Taken 96, Served 11, Walked out 0, Passed 60, per-good 'sold/spoiled/left' matching sales and stock, Rent: 30, Coins: 68, Reputation: 61, Tomorrow: Rain (forecast day 2).
Enter on Evening: [Upgrades, Coins: 68, Next day, Second till: 80, Cool box: 40, Sign: 30, Extra crates: 50, Awning: 35]; Next day -> morning day 2.

Sign bought: coins 68->38, upgrades [sign], 'Sign: owned', second Enter no change; Second till with 68 coins: 'Not enough coins', nothing changed; Extra crates -> crate_limit 12 and 'Crates: 10 of 12'.
Coins -21 after rent: Evening ends 'Bankrupt', slots all null; Enter -> season_over [Bankrupt, Score: 0, Days: 3, Best: 0, Enter: title]; records got {score 0, days 3, easy, bankrupt true}.
3-day season ending with 8 coins, rep 61: Evening 'Season over'; Enter -> [Season over, Score: 69, Days: 3, Best: 69]; slot emptied and title without Continue.

After 6 ended seasons: records 69, 65, 65, 65, then 'Score 0, 3 days, Normal, bankrupt' (earlier zero kept over later Hard zero); records screen showed those lines in a later run; empty shows 'No records yet'.

Fresh place: Evening had 'Stamp: First coin', 'Stamp: Sold out'; same stamps not repeated on a later evening; stamps in order; Stamps screen in a later run: 'First coin: yes', 'Sold out: yes', others ': no'.
First coin after a paying visitor; 'Stamp: Full stall' on a day opened with 8 crates; 'Stamp: Whole season' at end of a 3-day season with coins 8.
Sold out earned when apples/bread with crates were sold to 0; the rule only counts goods with a crate when the day opened (lib.rs:783), and the honey order emptying stock was not counted.
Day 3 played after Continue in a later run (other seed) gave a byte-identical evening state (visitors, sales, coins 42, texts) to the unbroken run.
Two fresh places, same seed/ticks/script: identical output (same md5); seed 2 gave another forecast, prices and visitor list.
Escape/Left/put on Evening, Left on title, put/rush/finish/take/price_up/next_good on Morning, accept/finish on Stall: state unchanged apart from tick.
modules/work/data/game.json holds goods, visitor types, hourly rates, weather weights/W, upgrades, stamps; README 'Changing things' says how to change a good, type, upgrade or stamp.

stall.png: text grid rows with [Ap]/[Br] crates at the state's cells, cursor <--> at (2,0), 'Good: Bread', 'Price: 6', 'Crates: 4 of 8'. Text only, but every element is there and placed as in the state.

day.png at 09:38: stall rows with crates, 'Aisle: [--] [--] [B12] [--] [--] [C11]' matching aisle x 2 and 5 with type letters, Queue: empty, 'Till 1: C10 until 09:41', time, Speed: Rush, Coins, Taken, Served, Reputation.

Title, slots, settings, morning, upgrades, paused and season over frames show their texts with '>' on the chosen row, but the Evening frame shows only '{work.tx0}' and the two 'Stamp:' lines (no Evening, Taken, goods, Rent, Coins...); the run also warns that nothing keeps work.tx0.
README has keys/flow (how to play), where kept (--settings folder settings.json k_settings, k_slot1..3, k_stamps, k_records) and the play and frame commands, both of which worked as written.

defects: The Evening's frame is broken: it draws '{work.tx0}' and the stamp lines only, and every run that reaches the Evening prints the engine warning 'a screen shows {work.tx0}: nothing keeps work.tx0'.
Kept settings and slots load at tick 1: a 0-tick headless run on a place with Spanish/Hard/3 days kept prints en/normal/7 and the default title.

Several words at one tick ('T:a+b') act in a fixed order rather than the order given, and a repeated word acts once ('0:down+down+down+down+enter' opened Records, not Settings); the brief asks for words at the same tick to act one after another in the order given.
Frames are a small text panel in the top-left corner (crates as two-letter codes, visitors as letter+id); nothing is drawn as pictures.
could_not_check: d37: no visitor ever waited in a queue long enough to walk out in 8 played days (max queue length 1), so the walk-out effects could not be observed.

where.how: weighted_by_kind is exact (the run's own token counts times the weights); a step's kind is a reading of its command's text, and answered_tokens / written_tokens are characters / 4
